description: The event object of onPopupOpen (epic 4 entry 14, docs/contract.md): fired wherever the Gateway is told popup.open, so a new segment of the same line is a new open. Edit mode opens no popup and fires none.

itemId.description: The id of the map item whose popup opened.

segment.description: For a line, the segment its popup opened at: the ids of the items at its two ends (start and end for a floating end), or null for a point or a line with no measuring instrument.
